case: CSV export/import of computed COALESCE results over STRICT ANY
contract: A COALESCE result over STRICT ANY retains conservative fallback metadata while producing INTEGER, REAL, fallback TEXT for SQL NULL, stored TEXT, BLOB, and tag-prefix-shaped TEXT.
The app result-file writer and CSV importer restore these values into INTEGER, ANY, and TEXT destination columns.
Native typeof() and returned values confirm the STRICT ANY destination retains each runtime storage class, including exact REAL value and BLOB bytes.
This proves the named SQLite COALESCE-to-CSV-to-native-import path; other computed-expression consumers remain open.

app_sqlite_any_contracts.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_any_contract:: -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other computed-expression types and consumers, spreadsheet-application re-import, and installed editing remain unproven.
